items.title: Gingerbread Walker with a Candy Cane
items.alt: Long-legged gingerbread character in a green icing vest and red bow tie walking with a tall striped candy cane.
items.description: Closed crescent eyes, gold candy buttons and crossed cookie legs give the walker a lighthearted stride.

items.title: Gingerbread Peeking from a Cookie Jar
items.alt: Round-eyed gingerbread character peeking out of a clear jar containing two iced star cookies, with a red gingham bow around the neck.
items.description: Two small cookie hands rest on the glass rim beneath a surprised open mouth and wavy icing hairline.

items.title: Gingerbread Riding a Peppermint Sled
items.alt: Laughing gingerbread character in a blue pom-pom cap and cream scarf seated on a red sled with striped candy-cane runners.
items.description: Both rounded cookie arms rise in delight, with two red peppermint buttons centered above the seated feet.

items.title: Gingerbread Girl Holding a Heart Cookie
items.alt: Seated gingerbread girl with an icing braid and lavender skirt hugging a large red heart cookie with white piping.
items.description: Purple flowers and bows decorate the long braid, while a small icing heart sits within the larger heart she holds.

items.title: Gingerbread Posting a Letter
items.alt: Slender gingerbread courier with a diamond-shaped head, burgundy cape and blue satchel posting a letter in a green mailbox.
items.description: A peppermint clasp fastens the sweeping cape, and the open mailbox stands on a red-and-white striped post.

items.title: Gingerbread Carrying a Star Lantern
items.alt: Small gingerbread character in a teal pointed cap and navy coat holding a gold star-shaped lantern.
items.description: The tilted head and pursed icing mouth face the lantern, whose handle hangs from a raised cookie hand.
